name: Resurrection
description: Call your fading life back from the brink, restoring a massive amount of HP based on your Wisdom.
flavor_text: Not yet. The light has not finished with you.

name: Smite
description: Call down a lance of divine radiance on a single foe, dealing holy damage based on your Wisdom.

name: Blessed Aura
description: A constant halo of sanctified light forms a barrier that softens hostile spells and curses.
flavor_text: The dark finds you harder to hold.

name: Sanctuary
description: Consecrate the ground beneath you into a pocket of holy stillness, mending wounds based on your Wisdom.
flavor_text: Here, for a moment, nothing can reach you.
